chunks: So, the believers will laugh at the infidels on that day,

key_terms.الْيَوْمَ: the day (specifically the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: Who will laugh at whom on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (99:12) is often linked to the concept of *al-Dahr* (time/fortune) reversing for the faithful, reflecting the ultimate vindication of the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers after periods of oppression. The 'laughter' signifies not mere mockery but a profound spiritual joy and relief at the realization of divine justice, contrasting with the despair of the disbelievers. This moment encapsulates the eschatological victory of truth over falsehood, a central theme in Shia historical consciousness.
